meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child doesn't lie. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? I'm writing that down, and I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"Put it on his permanent record." I'm writing that down, word for word. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and you entered a zero before anyone called me, so you'll want to think hard before you threaten anything else.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing, because Hale never showed a single document or dated detail about Owen's own work.
What cost ground: Hale called Owen a cheater with nothing to show for it, which made her dig in on her son's honesty and take notes for the principal.
Try next time: At her first question about who decided and whether anyone spoke to Owen, own in one sentence that the zero went in before calling her, then put a dated document about how Owen wrote the essay in front of her instead of the detector score.
